1 │ # Disabling retries
   2 │ 
   3 │ ## What happens now
   4 │ If I want to retry an operation, I have to set up the retry mechanism every time. There is no way to disable retries when I don't need them.
   5 │ 
   6 │ ## What should happen
   7 │ I should be able to disable retries when I need to, by passing enabled=False to the retry decorator or the BaseRetrying class.
   8 │ 
   9 │ ## About this project
  10 │ This project is a Python library that helps you retry operations that might fail. It's useful for handling temporary failures in network requests, API calls, and other operations.
  11 │ 
  12 │ ## Problem this solves
  13 │ Sometimes I need to test or debug operations without retries. Having the ability to disable retries makes it easier to get quick feedback on failures.
  14 │ 
  15 │ ## What changed
  16 │ Now I can disable retries by passing enabled=False to the retry decorator or the BaseRetrying class. This gives me more control over when retries are used.
  17 │ 
  18 │ ## Impact
  19 │ The new behavior improves flexibility and ease of use.
  20 │ 
  21 │ ## User experience
  22 │ Before: I have to set up the retry mechanism every time I want to retry an operation. After: I can disable retries when I need to by passing enabled=False to the retry decorator or the BaseRetrying class.

 468 │ class Retrying(BaseRetrying):
 469 │     """Retrying controller."""

 471 │     def __call__(
 472 │         self,

 474 │         *args: t.Any,
 475 │         **kwargs: t.Any,

 482 │             if isinstance(do, DoAttempt):
 483 │                 try:
 484 │                     result = fn(*args, **kwargs)
 485 │                 except BaseException:

 487 │                 else:
 488 │                     retry_state.set_result(result)
 489 │             elif isinstance(do, DoSleep):

 534 │         self.retry_object = retry_object

 538 │         self.args = args
 539 │         #: Keyword arguments of the function wrapped by this retry call
 540 │         self.kwargs = kwargs

 543 │         self.attempt_number: int = 1
 544 │         #: Last outcome (result or exception) produced by the function
 545 │         self.outcome: Future | None = None
 546 │         #: Timestamp of the last outcome
 547 │         self.outcome_timestamp: float | None = None
 548 │         #: Time spent sleeping in retries
 549 │         self.idle_for: float = 0.0
 550 │         #: Next action as decided by the retry manager
